justification: The only shared depicted content is the human form: A shows figures in profile leading horned rams in a processional register framed by rosette bands and a stylised tree, while B is a frontal, stacked pillar of schematic heads with staring lozenge eyes and bared teeth. The relationships (herders driving animals in a narrative frieze) and rendering conventions (fine incised, naturalistic profile relief) have nothing in common with B's blocky frontal totemic massing.
